mapper.insert: insert into address (user_id, consignee, phone, province, city, district, detail, label, is_default, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{consignee}, #{phone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detail}, #{label}, #{isDefault}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: delete from address where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select * from address where user_id = #{userId} order by is_default desc, id desc
mapper.update: update address set is_default = 0 where user_id = #{userId}
update address set is_default = 1 where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from address where user_id = #{userId}
